{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for any missing values in biomarker_final (NaN) before replacement
df_before = df.copy()
print("Number of NaN values in biomarker_final before replacement:", df_before['biomarker_final'].isna().sum())

# Check for any other sentinel values or invalid values (e.g., -999.0)
print("Number of -999.0 values in biomarker_final:", (df_before['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Replace -999.0 with NaN
df['biomarker_final'] = df['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)

# Now check for missing values after replacement
print("Number of NaN values in biomarker_final after replacement:", df['biomarker_final'].isna().sum())

# Compute the mean
mean_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (after cleaning): {mean_final}")"}
